direction: D5: Lowering the measurement noise floor
title: Noise floor of the deepseek-v4-flash solver on the PJLAB route: request parameters cannot lower it; serving-mode drift between sessions found; design rules and item counts priced
verdict_cn: 可行性：中等。改请求参数降不了噪声，能改的只有实验设计；另外发现一个新的偏差来源，修正几乎不花钱。①同一段Skill（附加在提示里的说明文字）、同一道题重跑两次，判分不一致的概率：空模板约10%，写明答题格式的任务卡约5%。比较200道题时，单靠这种随机性，差值就会晃约4.6道（每题跑1次）或2.3道（每题跑4次）。要证明对新题也有效，加题目比加重跑次数更有用。②“跑3次投票取多数”只把波动降约24%，3次取平均能降67%，不要投票。③线路实测266次调用、约32万token（模型计费的字数单位）：随机种子参数和“只在概率最高的前k个词里选”的参数被网关直接丢掉；“只在累计概率前p的词里选”和温度参数有效，但温度0已经最稳；同时发1个或12个请求没有差别。④新发现：同样的请求在不同时段，模型会整体换风格（只答一句的回答占6%到93%不等），空模板的通过率因此差约5.8个百分点，任务卡不受影响。所以不同时段跑出的分数不能直接相减。建议：父Skill（作比较基准的那段说明）用任务卡；所有对比（包括论文终表）在同一时段交错着跑；每轮首尾加约160次调用的风格监测；按报告里的题量表定题数，小题库如OfficeQA（办公文档问答，74题）和ALFWorld（文字版家务任务，57题），用尽训练题也只能看出约9到12个百分点以上的差别；请平台方开启“结果可复现”模式并固定一套服务。
evidence:
MEASURED, cal-1 complete (8,800 cells; 6,008 pass / 2,777 fail / 15 unknown):
- P(two runs of the same item disagree): parent:A 0.117 and parent:B 0.102 (pooled 0.105). ids-full 0.049, seed-only 0.054, cand and control:3 0.161. Mixed items: 41/200 (parent:A), 18/200 (ids-full).
- The scorer is deterministic: 0 pairs with identical text and different verdict. Text differs in 73.8% of parent:A pairs. The per-token divergence hazard is about 3%.
- parent:A − parent:B: −0.0075 [−0.027, +0.012], 16/20/164, sign p = 0.62. One-run realizations: −12, +7, +2, −3 net items. Dispersion vs 20,000 re-splits: p_lower 0.078, no arm component.
- SD of the 200-item paired mean: 4.59 / 3.25 / 2.29 items at 1/2/4 runs (resampled 4.70 / 3.31 / 2.34).
- Majority-of-3: exact unbiased variance ratio 0.759, against 0.333 for the mean of 3. |t| is lower than mean-of-3 in all 7 arms with a non-trivial effect, e.g. ids-full 3.97 → 2.98.
- Item heterogeneity σ²_het: 0.014–0.077. The SE for new items is 1.2–2.2× the SE conditional on the panel.
- Failure-enriched 74-item set: ν 0.175.

MEASURED, serving drift (same request bytes, different sessions):
- Bare-answer share ranges 0.06–0.93 across sessions, and the scaffold and task-card texts switch together.
- Scaffold: v3 E-ds s1 train (87% bare) − cal-1 (13%) = +0.0575 [+0.019, +0.096], 44/15, p = 0.0002 on 200 items. Within v3, train → screen: +0.056, p = 0.034.
- Task card: +0.000 [−0.031, +0.031] and +0.001.
- No time structure inside cal-1 (lag-1 p = 0.47).

MEASURED, route:
- seed, top_k, n and logprobs are dropped: seed="not-an-integer" and top_k="abc" return 200; T1+seed gives 2/48 identical (= T1); T1+top_k=1 gives 0/48.
- top_p, temperature and max_tokens are passed to vLLM's validator. The 400 messages are vLLM's verbatim. T1+top_p=1e-6 gives 12/48 ≈ T0 9/48.
- No system_fingerprint.
- Concurrency 1 vs 12: 16/72 vs 19/72 identical; verdict differs 27/72 vs 23/72. Combined with the earlier pilot (36 items): p = 0.20 (text), 0.52 (verdict).
- Prefix-cache state is unrelated to style or reproducibility (within-item permutation p = 0.16–0.99).

ESTIMATED:
- cal-1's ν predicts 28.9 ± 3.4 of 194 items to change between two 2-run measurements of the same text; v3 observed 30.
- MDE with the whole training pool (2 runs, σ²_het 0.035): SearchQA 3.2, OfficeQA 9.3, LiveMath 5.6, SpreadsheetBench 9.0, ALFWorld 12.0 points.

CLAIM (cited): nondeterminism comes from load-dependent batch composition, and the fix is server-side (batch-invariant kernels) at about 1.3–2× cost.
design:
Measurement design that the data supports:
- R1: The reference/parent text in measurement-critical comparisons pins the answer format (the task card). This halves ν and makes verdicts immune to the serving-mode drift. For empty-scaffold experiments, add a fixed answer-format line.
- R2: Every compared arm (candidate, parent, controls, and the final stage table: NoSkill, baselines, each stage Skill) is dispatched in one shuffled pool in one session. Never difference numbers from different sessions, and re-run reused step-0 evaluations alongside the new ones.
- R3: Drift canary per round: 40 fixed training items × 2 runs of the empty scaffold at the start and end. Record bare share, ν and pass rate; flag a canary bare share more than about 0.15 off the reference. Record every arm's bare share as a covariate.
- R4: Average runs; never majority-vote.
- R5/R6: Size panels from the item-count table n = 7.849·(σ²_het + ν/r)/δ² (power 0.8, two-sided 0.05).
  - Fixed-panel gates: 2–4 runs.
  - Generalization claims: 1–2 runs on more items.
  - State each design's MDE.
  - Small pools (OfficeQA 74, SpreadsheetBench 120, ALFWorld 57) need generated items (D6), cross-benchmark pooling, or version-level acceptance (D1/D8) to see effects below about 7–12 points.
- R7: Operator request: a batch-invariant evaluation endpoint, one pinned serving, and a fingerprint. The acceptance test is d5r2_pilot.py P1 T0 + P2: all T0 repeats must be byte-identical, and the canary must be stable across days.
- R8: Drop seed, top_k, top_p and concurrency tuning; keep temperature 0.
- R9: Report the SE conditional on the panel and the item-sampling SE, plus ν per session and per text (D11).

pilot.result:
266 calls from the new machine (310 HTTP sends, 44 retried after 429/5xx, 319,043 tokens). Training items only; each request was SHA-256-verified against cal-1 parent:A.

P0 (10 calls):
- The gateway accepts and drops seed (even "not-an-integer"), top_k (even "abc"), n=2 (returns 1 choice) and logprobs.
- It forwards top_p, temperature and max_tokens to a validator whose 400 messages are verbatim vLLM.
- There is no system_fingerprint.

P1 (160 calls, 8 items × 4 repeats; identical pairs of 48):
- T0 9, T1 2, T1+seed=777 2 (seed ignored), T1+top_k=1 0 (ignored; 0/6 items vs T0, p=0.031), T1+top_p=1e-6 12 (honoured, greedy-like; 5/0 items vs T1, p=0.062).
- No parameter makes T0 reproducible.

P2 (96 calls, 12 mixed items × 4 rounds):
- Sequential vs 12 concurrent: identical 16/72 vs 19/72; verdict differs 27/72 vs 23/72; item-level p = 0.73 / 0.625.
- With the earlier 288-call pilot over 36 items: p = 0.20 (text), 0.52 (verdict). No concurrency effect.

No client-visible serving identity:
- Headers, ids and usage fields are identical for bare and verbose replies.
- The prefix cache works in 256-token blocks and is consistent with about 4–5 cache domains. Its state is unrelated to style or reproducibility (p = 0.16–0.99).

risks:
- Single benchmark: the cal-1-based figures are SearchQA only. The other benchmarks' ν come from 57–100 items × 2 runs (SE 0.03–0.05).
- Small pilots: 8/12/24 items. They exclude large effects (an honoured seed, a deterministic serving) but not concurrency effects of a few points.
- Observational drift evidence: sessions were not randomized. The two-serving mechanism is a hypothesis supported by the repository's thinking/non-thinking probe note, with no client-visible confirmation.
- σ²_het rests on 10 specific texts, and the controls are not null (control:3 −10 points).
- The vLLM attribution rests on verbatim validator messages.
- The 4–5 cache domains assume random routing and no eviction.
- Run exchangeability is not perfect (one-run split p = 0.07). Text identity decays within a session (0.364 → 0.305), so a long session can straddle a mode switch, as v3 E-ds s1 did between train and screen.
- Two items from the earlier draft were not re-verified: the truncation-by-benchmark table and the adaptive-allocation analysis.
- The operator's ability to offer batch invariance for DeepSeek-V4 is unknown (not on vLLM's validated list).
cost_estimate:
Exploration spend:
- This pass: 266 calls, 0.319 M tokens.
- Earlier D5 attempt's pilot: 288 calls, 0.554 M reported tokens.
- All analyses were free (existing data).

Adopting the recommendations:
- R1, R4, R8, R9: 0.
- R2: no new kind of cost. Re-running the final stage table in one session is the price of one fresh evaluation, at the existing panel sizes (owner decision for test panels).
- R3 canary: 160 calls ≈ 0.2 M tokens per round.
- R7 acceptance test: 128–256 calls ≈ 0.16–0.32 M tokens on our side. The operator's cost is about 1.3–2× latency (claim).

Panel sizing on SearchQA, both arms, about 1,594 tokens per call:
- δ = 5 points, σ²_het 0.035, ν 0.105: 440 items × 1 run = 880 calls ≈ 1.4 M tokens, or 275 × 2 = 1,100 calls ≈ 1.75 M.
- δ = 3 points: 3.9–6.8 M tokens per comparison.
- Fixed-panel δ = 3 points: 1,832 calls ≈ 2.9 M at any r.
- Long-prompt texts like ids-full cost about 2.4× per call.
recommendation:
Adopt now, at zero cost:
- Use the format-pinning task card as the parent/reference text.
- Interleave every comparison, including the paper's final table, in one session, and stop differencing cross-session numbers.
- Average runs and never vote.
- Drop seed, top_k, top_p and concurrency tuning; keep temperature 0.
- Report both SE components.

Add a 160-call drift canary per round.

Size every future panel with the item-count table before launch, and state its MDE.
- On OfficeQA, SpreadsheetBench and ALFWorld the whole training pool cannot resolve less than about 7–12 points, so transfer claims there need generated items (D6) or version-level acceptance (D1/D8).

Send one request to the PJLAB route operator: a batch-invariant evaluation endpoint, a pinned single serving, and a serving fingerprint. The acceptance scripts are ready.
- Note that determinism would remove only the same-text noise ν. Text-perturbation heterogeneity (σ²_het 0.014–0.041 for irrelevant edits) remains, so controls stay necessary.

Do not spend budget on client-side determinism tricks.
